subject: lipid nanoparticle formulation
statement: Lipid nanoparticle formulation procedure: (1) Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits. (2) Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification. (3) Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations. (4) Perform lipid nanoparticle formulation according to the approved batch record instructions. (5) Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time. (6) Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing. (7) Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-1488-21. (8) Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-4582-39.
